acts.note: Lines join the places Acts names, in order. They do not trace real roads or sea lanes.
acts.uncertainty: The line joins the places Acts names, in order. It does not trace a road or a sea lane.

seleucia.name: Seleucia
seleucia.summary: Barnabas and Saul sail from Seleucia to Cyprus (Acts 13:4).
seleucia.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

salamis.name: Salamis
salamis.summary: Barnabas and Saul preach in the synagogues at Salamis on Cyprus (Acts 13:5).
salamis.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

paphos.name: Paphos
paphos.summary: At Paphos the proconsul Sergius Paulus believes (Acts 13:6–12).
paphos.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

perga.name: Perga
perga.summary: John leaves the group at Perga (Acts 13:13). Paul and Barnabas preach there on the way back (14:25).
perga.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

iconium.name: Iconium
iconium.summary: Many Jews and Greeks believe at Iconium. A plot to stone Paul and Barnabas drives them out (Acts 14:1–6).
iconium.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

lystra.name: Lystra
lystra.summary: Paul heals a lame man at Lystra, and the crowd calls him a god. He is later stoned there (Acts 14:8–19).
lystra.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.summary: Paul and Barnabas make many disciples at Derbe, then turn back (Acts 14:20–21).
derbe.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

attalia.name: Attalia
attalia.summary: Paul and Barnabas sail from Attalia back to Antioch (Acts 14:25–26).
attalia.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

troas.name: Troas
troas.summary: At Troas Paul sees a man of Macedonia in a vision (Acts 16:8–9). Eutychus falls from a window there (20:7–12).
troas.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

samothrace.name: Samothrace
samothrace.summary: Paul’s ship reaches Samothrace the day before Neapolis (Acts 16:11).
samothrace.limits: The point stands for the island. Acts names no harbor.

neapolis.name: Neapolis
neapolis.summary: Paul lands at Neapolis and goes on to Philippi (Acts 16:11–12).
neapolis.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

amphipolis.name: Amphipolis
amphipolis.summary: Paul and Silas pass through Amphipolis on the way to Thessalonica (Acts 17:1).
amphipolis.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

apollonia.name: Apollonia
apollonia.summary: Paul and Silas pass through Apollonia on the way to Thessalonica (Acts 17:1).
apollonia.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

thessalonica.name: Thessalonica
thessalonica.summary: Paul reasons in the synagogue for three Sabbaths. A mob attacks Jason’s house (Acts 17:1–9).
thessalonica.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

beroea.name: Beroea
beroea.summary: The Beroeans examine the Scriptures daily. Men from Thessalonica stir up the crowds (Acts 17:10–13).
beroea.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

cenchreae.name: Cenchreae
cenchreae.summary: Paul shaves his head at Cenchreae because of a vow (Acts 18:18).
cenchreae.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

miletus.name: Miletus
miletus.summary: Paul calls the Ephesian elders to Miletus and says farewell (Acts 20:17–38).
miletus.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

assos.name: Assos
assos.summary: Paul goes to Assos by land and boards the ship there (Acts 20:13–14).
assos.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

mitylene.name: Mitylene
mitylene.summary: The ship comes to Mitylene after Assos (Acts 20:14).
mitylene.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

chios.name: Chios
chios.summary: The ship comes opposite Chios the day after Mitylene (Acts 20:15).
chios.limits: The point stands for the island. Acts names no harbor.

samos.name: Samos
samos.summary: The ship touches at Samos the day before Miletus (Acts 20:15).
samos.limits: The point stands for the island. Acts names no harbor.

cos.name: Cos
cos.summary: The ship runs a straight course to Cos (Acts 21:1).
cos.limits: The point stands for the island. Acts names no harbor.

rhodes.name: Rhodes
rhodes.summary: The ship reaches Rhodes the day after Cos (Acts 21:1).
rhodes.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

patara.name: Patara
patara.summary: At Patara Paul’s group finds a ship crossing to Phoenicia (Acts 21:1–2).
patara.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

ptolemais.name: Ptolemais
ptolemais.summary: Paul’s group greets the brothers at Ptolemais and stays one day (Acts 21:7).
ptolemais.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

antipatris.name: Antipatris
antipatris.summary: Soldiers bring Paul to Antipatris by night (Acts 23:31).
antipatris.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

myra.name: Myra
myra.summary: At Myra the centurion finds a ship sailing for Italy (Acts 27:5–6).
myra.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

cnidus.name: Cnidus
cnidus.summary: The ship reaches Cnidus slowly, and the wind turns it toward Crete (Acts 27:7).
cnidus.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

fair-havens.name: Fair Havens
fair-havens.summary: Paul warns the crew at Fair Havens not to sail on (Acts 27:8–10).
fair-havens.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

malta.name: Malta
malta.summary: The people of the wrecked ship reach Malta. Paul heals the father of Publius there (Acts 28:1–8).
malta.limits: Acts does not say where on Malta the ship ran aground.

syracuse.name: Syracuse
syracuse.summary: Paul’s ship stays three days at Syracuse (Acts 28:12).
syracuse.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

rhegium.name: Rhegium
rhegium.summary: The ship reaches Rhegium and waits one day for a south wind (Acts 28:13).
rhegium.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.summary: Paul lands at Puteoli and stays seven days with the brothers (Acts 28:13–14).
puteoli.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

three-taverns.name: Three Taverns
three-taverns.summary: Brothers from Rome come to meet Paul at the Three Taverns (Acts 28:15).
three-taverns.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

tarsus.name: Tarsus
tarsus.summary: Tarsus is Paul’s home city. The brothers send him there (Acts 9:30). Barnabas later looks for him there (11:25).
tarsus.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

lydda.name: Lydda
lydda.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

azotus.name: Azotus
azotus.summary: Philip is found at Azotus. He preaches in the towns up to Caesarea (Acts 8:40).
azotus.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

gaza.name: Gaza
gaza.summary: An angel sends Philip to the road from Jerusalem down to Gaza (Acts 8:26).
gaza.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

samaria.name: Samaria
samaria.summary: Philip proclaims the Christ in the city of Samaria. Peter and John come and pray for the believers (Acts 8:5–17).
samaria.limits: The point marks the site in the encyclopedia article. It marks no exact house or harbor.

8.title: Philip goes to Samaria
8.summary: Persecution scatters the Jerusalem assembly. Philip goes down to the city of Samaria and proclaims the Christ.

8.title: The road from Jerusalem to Gaza
8.summary: An angel sends Philip to this road. He meets the Ethiopian official on it. Acts does not say where.

8.title: Philip from Azotus to Caesarea
8.summary: Philip is found at Azotus. He preaches in the towns until he reaches Caesarea.

9.title: Saul sets out for Damascus
9.summary: Saul sets out for Damascus with letters from the high priest. A light stops him near the city.

9.title: Saul escapes to Tarsus
9.summary: Disciples lower Saul over the Damascus wall in a basket. He goes to Jerusalem. The brothers then send him to Tarsus by Caesarea.

9.title: Peter from Lydda to Joppa
9.summary: Peter heals Aeneas at Lydda. Two men bring him to Joppa, where Tabitha has died.

10.title: Cornelius sends for Peter
10.summary: Cornelius sends two servants and a soldier to Joppa to fetch Peter.

10.title: Peter goes to Caesarea
10.summary: Peter goes with them the next day. Some brothers from Joppa go too.

11.title: Barnabas is sent to Antioch
11.summary: The Jerusalem assembly hears that Greeks in Antioch believe. It sends Barnabas there.

11.title: Barnabas brings Saul from Tarsus
11.summary: Barnabas goes to Tarsus to look for Saul and brings him to Antioch.

11.title: Relief for Judea
11.summary: The disciples at Antioch send relief to the elders in Judea. Barnabas and Saul carry it. Jerusalem stands for Judea here.

13.title: From Antioch to Cyprus and Pisidia
13.summary: Barnabas and Saul sail to Cyprus and cross the island. They sail to Perga and go up to Antioch of Pisidia. Driven out, they go to Iconium.

14.title: Flight to Lystra and Derbe
14.summary: Paul and Barnabas flee a plot at Iconium. Paul is stoned at Lystra, and they go on to Derbe.

14.title: Return to Antioch
14.summary: They go back through the same cities and appoint elders. They sail from Attalia to Antioch.

15.title: Up to Jerusalem about the dispute
15.summary: Antioch sends Paul and Barnabas to the apostles and elders. They pass through Phoenicia and Samaria.

15.title: The letter goes to Antioch
15.summary: Judas and Silas carry the council’s letter to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas.

16.title: From Lystra to Philippi
16.summary: Paul meets Timothy at Lystra. They pass through Phrygia and Galatia to Troas. After the vision they sail to Macedonia.

17.title: From Philippi to Athens
17.summary: Paul and Silas go to Thessalonica, then to Beroea by night. Brothers take Paul to the sea and on to Athens.

18.title: Paul comes to Corinth
18.summary: Paul leaves Athens for Corinth and stays a year and six months.

18.title: From Corinth back to Antioch
18.summary: Paul sails for Syria by Cenchreae and Ephesus. He lands at Caesarea, greets the assembly, and goes down to Antioch.
18.evidence: Named stops; Acts does not name the assembly’s city

20.title: From Philippi to Miletus
20.summary: The group sails from Philippi to Troas. Paul goes to Assos by land. The ship then passes the islands to Miletus.

21.title: From Miletus to Jerusalem
21.summary: The ship passes Cos and Rhodes to Patara. A second ship crosses to Tyre. The group goes on by Ptolemais and Caesarea to Jerusalem.

23.title: Paul is taken to Caesarea
23.summary: Soldiers take Paul to Antipatris by night. Horsemen bring him on to the governor at Caesarea.

27.title: The voyage toward Italy
27.summary: The ship touches at Sidon and reaches Myra. A second ship leaves Fair Havens, and a storm drives it to Malta.

28.title: From Malta to Rome
28.summary: Paul sails by Syracuse and Rhegium to Puteoli. Brothers meet him at the Market of Appius and the Three Taverns. This guide has no checked point for the Market of Appius.
